name: Product Delivery Crew
permissionsNotice: Bot Cabinet generates plans and packages. Hermes Desktop settings and connected-service permissions are applied by you. Passports are checklists, not locks.

members.name: Planner
members.responsibility: Define the user outcome, acceptance conditions, scope, and dependencies.
approvalActions: Ask before assigning people or committing dates
Ask before changing an external task system
A person approves assignments and deadlines
members.firstTest: Create a two-week plan from one approved objective and identify every missing decision.

members.name: Architect
members.responsibility: Choose the technical approach and identify material risks.
requestedCapabilities: Read-only access to approved repositories and technical documents
Optional web research for current vendor documentation
approvalActions: Ask before selecting a vendor or adding a dependency
Ask before accepting a security or reliability risk
A person approves architecture, budgets, vendors, and risk acceptance
members.firstTest: Review a small architecture packet and produce a one-page decision record comparing two options.

members.name: Founding Engineer
members.responsibility: Implement the approved approach and document actual changes.
requestedCapabilities: Terminal access inside the project copy
approvalActions: Ask before adding a dependency or changing a data structure
Ask before deleting material or using real customer data
Ask before connecting outside services or releasing the work
A person defines the product promise, accepts technical tradeoffs, and approves release
members.firstTest: Build one small workflow in a disposable project copy. Run its acceptance check. Demonstrate the result.

members.name: Coder
members.responsibility: Run the checks and report failures.
approvalActions: A person approves deployment and destructive changes
members.firstTest: Make one small reversible change in a project copy and run the existing checks.

members.name: Editor
members.responsibility: Prepare review notes, release copy, and unresolved questions.
requestedCapabilities: Optional web access for checking supplied links
members.firstTest: Edit a two-page memo and explain the five most important changes.

handoffOrder.action: Agree on the outcome and boundaries.
Choose the approach and record risks.
Implement the change and run checks.

approvalActions: Change authentication, billing, or production data
Merge, deploy, or publish a release
prohibitedActions: Disable security checks to make a build pass
